newsitem.title: USA: Texas spot electricity moves higher despite heat.
newsitem.headline: Texas spot electricity moves higher despite heat.

text.p: Spot wholesale electricity prices in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) were stronger Monday with support from historically strong natural gas prices, industry sources said.
The upward movement on short-term power deals came despite mild temperatures in the 70 degrees Fahrenheit area.
Spot gas prices in Texas were said to have eased Monday but brokers and marketers said they remained at historically high levels, giving support to electricity prices.
ERCOT firm, peak power for Tuesday delivery was pegged at $33.00-34.00 from $29.00-31.00 late last week, the sources said.
"It's all gas that's giving it strength," said one ERCOT marketer.
Firm off-peak ERCOT power transactions were pegged steady at $11.00-14.00, the sources said.
ERCOT January/February peak power prices fell in line with cheaper natural gas futures to $30.50-31.00 from $31.75-32.25 late last week, the sources said.
Temperatures in Texas were forecast to be warmer Tuesday with some areas reaching as high as the mid-80s degrees Fahrenheit.
Over the longer term, temperatures were expected to be five to 15 degrees above normal through the week.
